description: Six Mile Water Network Contribution is a series of datasets listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by OpenDataNI. About this layer Network contribution area scores were exported from the SciMAP application outputs within SAGA GIS. The scores were based on inputs from CEH Land cover 2007, Met Office average rainfall and 5 meter DTM. The High contribution category boundary was determined by selecting +1 standard deviation of the distribution of the scores. Coverage: OpenDataNI. The portal lists 11 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher OpenDataNI. Its tags are High Network Contribution, NI, Northern Ireland, Rivers, Surface Flow. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, JSON, KML. The portal shows 2022-08-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
